name: @w6w-apps/memberstack
description: Manage Memberstack members and free-plan connections, verify member tokens, and read and write Data Table records through the Memberstack Admin REST API.

w6w.longDescription:
Memberstack adds sign-up, login, gated content and Stripe-backed plans to a site without a backend of its own. This app drives its server-side Admin REST API: the calls a backend, a no-code automation or a migration script makes on a member's behalf with a secret key.

It lists, fetches, creates, updates and deletes members (looked up by id or by email), adds and removes free plans, and verifies the JWT a member's browser presents so a workflow can trust who is calling. It also covers Data Tables, Memberstack's structured record store: list the tables, read a table's schema, and create, query, update and delete records, optionally owned by a member.

The secret key is a live key (sk_) or a sandbox key (sk_sb_); the key itself decides which environment every call touches. The front-end DOM SDK, webhooks and paid-plan checkout are not part of the Admin REST API and are not covered.
